newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Land finds hydrocarbons at well.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Land finds hydrocarbons at well.

text.p: The Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said it found a potentially significant accumulation of hydrocarbons in one of its major 3-D generated exploratory prospects in south Louisiana.

The company said it found the hydrocarbons in the Lower Miocene Discorbis 30 Sand at the Fresh Water Bayou C-1 well in Vermilion Parish. The hydrocarbons are in addition to about 50 feet of net gas pay in the Discorbis 26 Sand previously logged at the well.
The company said it still needs to perform production testing, which will take about three to four weeks.
